requirement_text.REQ-071: Mount Letflow.Plugs.AuthPipeline and Letflow.Plugs.TenantStatus (both built, compiled and tested by REQ-021, both explicitly "not mounted in front of any route today ... left available for S4" per their own moduledocs) in front of the tenant-scoped API surface, in that order. AC1: a request to a tenant-scoped path with no Authorization header returns 401. AC2: a request with a valid token reaches the handler. AC3: GET /health returns 200 while the OIDC provider configuration worker is unavailable (health stays outside the auth/tenant-status chain). AC4: a POST against a tenant whose status is :migrating returns 503; a tenant-status lookup failure on one request does not affect a concurrent request. AC6: both plugs' moduledocs no longer contain the phrase 'Not mounted in front of any route today'. AC7: the REQ-021 OQ-14 fail-open-vs-fail-closed divergence is explicitly confirmed by REVIEWER, recorded in docs/migration/stage-4-api-surface.md.
